<thought>We need to search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that match the forward reaction description: the forward reaction forms a C‑C bond (carbon‑carbon, atomic numbers 6‑6) and breaks a C‑O bond (6‑8). The functional groups that are lost (broken) in the forward direction are ketones and C‑C triple bonds. Using these criteria should return suitable templates.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C triple bonds"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
